what: A394183: the longest halting run of any 2-state 2-symbol machine (12^4 tables) on an n-cell circular tape, over every starting tape, head at cell 0, state A
command: cc -O2 -o circular circular.c && ./circular N [WORKERS INDEX], taking the largest max over the workers
checks: circular.c gives all 19 OEIS terms; tests/test_circular.py checks n = 1..14
a separate brute-force simulator (OEIS-style, Brent loop check) over all 20736 tables gives a(10), a(12), a(13)
the same simulator on the champion table gives every new term from n = 20 to 26
pattern: every term from n = 5 fits (n+1)(n+2)/2 for odd n (as the OEIS formula says), and every even term from n = 14 fits (n^2 - 3n + 8)/2; observed, not proved
